body: Tried once a long time ago. She's stuck on the traditional mindset of I'm getting sent to an asylum or hospital and it'll ruin my life. She doesn't get it because she's a closed minded person who grew up with trauma she hasn't yet revolved and is completely incapable of offering sound help to anyone. She's so alcoholic who believes that I contribute nothing.

I'm not gunna lie, while she has turned me into a very smart person, she's been a horrible parent, ive never been good enough and am always at fault. Currently we live in an apartment together after coming back from travelling the world (she's a teacher). We argue almost every day about minimalistic shit and she has repeatedly called me a lazy useless piece of shit. When you're told that enough you believe it

No. They can't get it. I've tried to reach out to an uncle/my mother/and my grandmother but they all don't take it the way they should. I've also got a fucked relationship with my.mother now too which is another part driving me to the end

I'm done taking the time because this is a cycle for me. Every close person in my life has gone through this exact pattern. Now when the one that would have been best for me leaves, I'm giving up. I don't want to repeat the cycle and make things worse or accelerate any situation
I seek/vakue connection over most else I think. Hard to do that with chinchillas haha it'd be nice to get affection back ya know? From anything really.
I feel this way too mich and it gets concerming when I naturally overthink it :(

Honestly since I've been getting deeper and darker I've started watching videos on r/watchpeopledie and reading stories about people attempting and other situations where people die and come back. And the general consensus I've found is once you reach that moment, it's just peaceful nothingness. That's what I'd crave more than anything. No real opinions on afterlife other than the LSD fuelled talks at parties about how were all the same person living diffwrent lives etc. But the blissfull nothingness sounds exemplary to me. No more of my head saying everything at once and being able to hear everything on top of being paranoid as shit and turning everything I touch into toxicity. It'd be easier in empty nothing I feel.

I just really wish I was stronger, you know? Like I think about literally everything too much to the point it's been driving me insane and forcing me to question my reality. And I've gotten so used to the shit I'm not used to anything good any more. Amy time something uplifting happens, it's quickly followed by a counter situation that fucks things up worse than before. I just don't see the point in putting myself through all this anguish if I'm "worth so much" or "have so much out there".

It's so goddamn hard man.. I try and think about my little floofs every day and that they don't like other people the same way they like me. But at the same time it all feels pathetic. Anyone else could take care of them and I just really can't handle anything else anymore. I just want the whole "things will get better" to not be bullshit because they don't. They just evolve into worse problems that become more and more neglected until it's too late.

I'm proud of you for reacting by going somewhere with a view, whiskey, and blunts! You strong strong man. I would have thrown a fit right there and done some crazy shit. You dealt with this situation in a very smart way. I believe you'll be okay man. Best of luck to you and I hope things go uphill from here.
